title: movmedian
summary: Compute moving medians in MATLAB and RunMat.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs currently use a resident fallback: gather once to host for the moving-window median pass and re-upload the result when an acceleration provider is active. Median/order-statistics residency needs a dedicated provider hook.

description: `movmedian(A,k)` returns the median value in each sliding window.
behaviors: `k` may be a positive scalar window length or a two-element `[kb kf]` backward/forward window.
Pass an explicit `dim` to move along a chosen dimension.
`'includenan'` is the default; `'omitnan'` and `'omitmissing'` skip NaN values inside each window.
`'Endpoints'` supports `'shrink'` (default), `'discard'`, `'fill'`, and numeric scalar fill values.
`'SamplePoints', sp` uses a strictly increasing numeric point vector for irregular moving windows. With sample points, RunMat currently supports shrink endpoints.
For even window counts, the median is the average of the two middle values. Complex inputs are ordered by magnitude with phase as the tie breaker.
This implementation covers numeric, logical, complex, and gpuArray inputs; table/timetable `DataVariables` forms are tracked separately.

examples.description: Moving median with an even window
